formulations.Polymer system Notes: Commercial PEO (C-PEO, Aldrich), average MW 900000; contains catalytic residues/impurities and a low molecular weight fraction
formulations.Arrhenius notes: Apparent activation energy at T = 65 °C, read off Fig. 2 (approximate). Single-phase amorphous region; the text says Ea here is much lower and depends on concentration and PEO purity.
formulations.Notes: Polymer dried under dynamic partial vacuum (5 mm Hg of Ar) at 45-50 °C for ~48 h before use; salts recrystallized from acetonitrile and dried under dynamic partial vacuum for 48 h at 100-110 °C; handled in glove box; films cast from acetonitrile. Conductivity taken from the first temperature rise only.
formulations.Reference: D. Fauteux, J. Prud'homme, P.E. Harvey, Solid State Ionics 28-30 (1988) 923-928
